deployments_detail.use: Autonomous network operations: hierarchical AI agents running 24/7 with closed-loop automation that detect anomalies, spin up specialized sub-agents to find root causes, and self-heal the network, targeting Level 4 network autonomy. Engineers use frontier LLMs for complex modeling and traffic management. [Anthropic Claude (frontier LLMs)]
deployments_detail.value: Over 70 million autonomous network configuration changes executed in 2025; root-cause diagnosis cut from hours to under 2 minutes

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered private 5G with NVIDIA enterprise AI for live media: portable private 5G platform running real-time AI inference on video streams to dynamically prioritize camera feeds and auto-generate broadcast graphics (e.g., identifying jockeys by jersey color), piloted with FanDuel TV live race production. [NVIDIA (AI Enterprise, Holoscan for Media, NIM, L40S GPUs); Mistral 12B model]
deployments_detail.value: Over 50% lower latency versus traditional cloud workflows

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered customer experience (Google Gemini) — agent-assist reducing call times; reported sales lift

Personal Research Assistant: a conversational agent-assist tool that reviews thousands of internal resources to give ~28,000 frontline customer-care and retail reps instant, contextual answers to customer inquiries. Deployed at full scale after a July 2024 rollout. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Gemini, Agent Assist Panel)]
deployments_detail.value: 95% comprehensive answerability of customer inquiries; deployed across 28,000 reps

deployments_detail.use: Fast Pass to Resolution: AI that intelligently matches an incoming customer to the best-fit available representative based on their specific need (e.g., pairing international-service questions with international travel experts).

Problem Solver / Personal Shopper: real-time AI analysis of customer profiles that helps employees understand customer needs and deliver tailored answers, offers and products, and accelerates troubleshooting of complex issues. [Google Cloud (Customer Engagement Suite, Agent Assist Panel)]

AI-powered Verizon Assistant in the relaunched My Verizon consumer app: a customer-facing GenAI assistant that helps consumers manage upgrades, add lines, ask billing questions and troubleshoot complex issues, escalating to a human 'Customer Champion' when needed. [Google Cloud (Gemini models)]

Verizon Business Assistant: an industry-first GenAI-powered text-messaging solution for small businesses that automates responses to frequently asked customer questions and provides 24/7 automated engagement.
Generative AI for customer service agent support (call summarization, prompts, follow-up tracking)
AI-powered customer experience with chatbots, virtual assistants, and predictive analytics
AI agents to improve customer experiences and support frontline teams

'Segment of Me' personalization engine: generative-AI-driven system that delivers individually tailored offers and products to each customer across all shopping channels, powering the myPlan personalization strategy.
